```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggsci)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8
us <- read_csv("headline_all_cats.csv") |>
        filter(country == "United States") |>
        select(-1, -country, -`All Items`) |>
        rename_with(~ str_extract(.x, "\\w+"), -date) |>
        drop_na()

pca <- prcomp(select(us, -date), scale. = TRUE)
pct <- round(100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2))

scores <- as_tibble(pca$x[, 1:2]) |>
  mutate(year = factor(year(us$date)),
         month = month(us$date, label = TRUE))

mult <- 0.8 * max(abs(pca$x[, 1:2])) / max(abs(pca$rotation[, 1:2]))
arrows <- as_tibble(pca$rotation[, 1:2] * mult, rownames = "var")

ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_segment(data = arrows, aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), color = "grey60") +
  geom_text_repel(data = arrows, aes(label = var), color = "grey30", size = 3) +
  geom_point(aes(color = year)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = month, color = year), size = 2.5,
                  max.overlaps = 15, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_flatui() +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", pct[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", pct[2], "%)"),
       color = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()
```
